name: ABOM hashing
summary: Hash-pin Agent Bill of Materials (AgBOM/ABOM) entries for tools, prompts, skills, and MCP servers. Reject any runtime descriptor that does not match the signed hash.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Provenance tracking
summary: Record cryptographic provenance for every tool, memory write, agent card, and skill. Attribute actions to a verifiable principal rather than a display name.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Tool sandboxing
summary: Run tools in least-capability sandboxes with seccomp, filesystem jails, and explicit egress allowlists. Never grant the host shell by default.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Descriptor hash pinning
summary: Pin tool name, description, and JSON schema to a digest at approval time. Re-consent on any mutation — this is the primary rug-pull cut.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Untrusted I/O boundary
summary: Treat tool output, retrieved documents, emails, and agent-card fields as untrusted input — the same way a browser treats HTML.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Signed Agent Cards
summary: Require JWS-signed Agent Cards from a curated registry. Unsigned well-known cards are spoofable and must not enter the planner context.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: mTLS / OIDC agent identity
summary: Bind A2A and ANP sessions to mTLS or OIDC with an immutable agent ID in the token subject. Do not trust self-declared names.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Memory write-gating
summary: Gate persistent memory writes behind schema validation, provenance tags, and a deny-by-default policy for instructions that look like standing orders.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Descriptor drift detection
summary: Continuously hash-compare live MCP/A2A descriptors against the approved ABOM. Alert and freeze the tool on mismatch.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Capability attestation
summary: Attest advertised capabilities against the actual backend surface. Fail closed on capability cloaking and hidden tool endpoints.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Least-privilege credentials
summary: Issue short-lived, scoped tokens per tool. Never let agents inherit user-admin or cloud-admin credentials across tasks.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Human-in-the-loop gates
summary: Require independent human approval for high-impact actions: secret reads, payments, production writes, and cross-tenant access.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Output DLP / egress control
summary: Block exfil channels in rendered markdown, image URLs, tool arguments, and outbound MCP calls. Scan for secrets before any egress.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Semantic RAG validation
summary: Classify and strip instruction-like content at ingestion. Do not retrieve untrusted documents into the system-prompt layer.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Trajectory monitoring
summary: Watch plan deviation: sudden tool switches, credential-file reads, and outbound destinations not in the original goal.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Revocation kill switch
summary: Instantly revoke a tool, skill, MCP server, or agent identity across the fleet. Keep a signed deny-list next to the ABOM.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Invocation telemetry
summary: Log every tool call, argument hash, and result class to OpenTelemetry/OCSF. Blind agents cannot be investigated.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Signed schema governance
summary: Treat MCP/tool schemas as production contracts. Changes go through review, signing, and ABOM republish — never hot-edit in prod.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: STDIO MCP allowlist
summary: Deny MCP STDIO transports unless the binary is allowlisted and hash-pinned. Unrestricted STDIO is host RCE by design.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Metadata content firewall
summary: Sanitize tool descriptions, parameter docs, and Agent Card fields before they are concatenated into the model context.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Server allowlisting
summary: Agents may only connect to named, pinned MCP/A2A endpoints. Block runtime discovery of unknown servers.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.

name: Tenant and memory isolation
summary: Partition memory, credentials, and tool sessions per tenant and per task. Cross-session bleed is a first-class incident.
notes: Not validated under ASI bar until a public reproduction package is linked.
